name: Beta-alanine
notes: Candidate ingredient drafted from master research list v2 (2026-09-05), not yet expert-reviewed. Evidence base concentrates on high-intensity efforts lasting 60-240s (Hobson 2012; refined by a 2024 IJSNEM meta-analysis) - population/effect mapping onto the endurance_capacity outcome is an approximation and should be checked by the reviewer. Known benign side effect: paresthesia (skin tingling) at higher single doses, not modeled as a safety escalation here.
